summary: First-run verification of The Shenanigators cloned repo. Backend smoke suite (17 tests, pytest) passes 100% covering auth, events (incl. RSVP address visibility), blog (incl. drafts hidden), travel-packages, event submissions, and admin authorization. Frontend: all public routes load without console errors, registration/login/logout works, admin login grants /admin dashboard, logged-in non-admin sees 'Admins only' on /admin, RSVP flow reveals exact address only after RSVP and hides it after cancel.
action_items: Spec discrepancy (not a bug): Review request mentions route '/trips', but the app uses '/travel' (nav label is 'Trips'). Unknown '/trips' falls through to NotFound. Consider adding a '/trips' alias or redirect if '/trips' is the intended canonical URL.

Spec discrepancy (not a bug): Review request expects logged-out users on /admin to see 'Admins only'. Current behavior wraps /admin in RequireAuth and redirects to /auth (login). 'Admins only' is shown to logged-in non-admin users (verified). This is standard and arguably better UX; confirm with product.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 904 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth/events/blog/travel/submissions) for maintainability.
CORS_ORIGINS is set to '*' in backend/.env. With allow_credentials auto-disabled when origins == ['*'] this is handled, but production should restrict to the real site origin.
Admin promotion flow is manual (make_admin.py); good from a security standpoint, documented in test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up TEST_-prefixed events, blog posts, travel packages, and random email users. No persistent seed data added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a React + FastAPI + MongoDB community site (events/blog/trips/admin). Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend route for trips is /api/travel-packages; frontend route is /travel (not /trips). RequireAuth redirects unauth users to /auth. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_api_smoke.py and currently pass 17/17.
